fix_code:
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    n, t = map(int, input().split())

    tate = defaultdict(int)
    yoko = defaultdict(int)
    naname = [0, 0]

    A = list(map(int, input().split()))

    cnt = 0
    for a in A:
        a -= 1

        i = a // n
        j = a % n
        tate[i] += 1
        yoko[j] += 1
        if i == j:
            naname[0] += 1
        if i + j == n - 1:
            naname[1] += 1
        cnt += 1
        if (
            tate[i] == n
            or yoko[j] == n
            or naname[0] == n
            or naname[1] == n
        ):
            print(cnt)
            return

    print(-1)
